meta.name: knowledge-agent
meta.description: Build and query AI-powered knowledge bases from claude-mem observations. Use when users want to create focused "brains" from their observation history, ask questions about past work patterns, or compile expertise on specific topics.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从对话历史构建可查询的知识库
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望从日常对话中自动提炼知识并随时查询
copy.tagline_en: Build queryable knowledge bases from conversation history
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to automatically extract knowledge from daily conversations and query it anytime

howto.what: 它把你的 claude-mem 观察记录筛选、编译成一个专属知识库,载入 AI 会话后你可以用对话方式提问,后续追问会保留上下文;还能列出、重建和重新载入这些知识库。
howto.when: 当你想从历史观察里建一个聚焦的知识库、询问过去的工作模式,或就某个主题汇编专业知识时,它就会接管。

say.text: 建个知识库,只收录 claude-mem 项目里 hooks 相关的观察
say.note: 会筛选出对应的观察集合并保存

say.text: 载入 hooks-expertise 这个知识库,我要开始提问
say.note: 创建带全部知识的 AI 会话

say.text: hooks 的五个生命周期钩子分别什么时候触发?
say.note: 从知识库内容中回答,并保留上下文

howto.what_en: It filters your claude-mem observations into a compiled knowledge base, loads it into an AI session, and lets you ask questions about it conversationally; follow-ups keep context. You can also list, rebuild, and reprime corpora.
howto.when_en: Use it when you want to build a focused knowledge base from your observation history, ask about past work patterns, or compile expertise on a topic.

say_en.text: Build a knowledge base from my claude-mem hooks observations
say_en.note: Filters and saves the matching observations

say_en.text: Prime the hooks-expertise corpus so I can ask questions
say_en.note: Loads it into an AI session

say_en.text: When do the 5 lifecycle hooks fire?
say_en.note: Answers from the corpus and keeps context
